thread:
Maya (AE): Heads up 1:10 UTC customer wants a BYO-HSM POC but also expects an automated "zero-downtime" rotation demo. They're asking for pricing delta vs our standard Dedicated plan and explicit audit retention limits.
Ravi (SalesEng): We should split pricing into: one-time connector engineering, monthly HSM ops (runbook + oncall), per-crypto-op surcharge, and extended audit retention. They want 2 years retention as an option.
Chris (Infra): Important: if keys never touch our control plane (pure HSM bridge) we avoid key custody concerns but incur latency and throughput constraints. Need HSM model details (Thales/Entrust/CloudHSM) to simulate QPS.
Nina (Security): Requirements from security review: hardware attestation cert, signed key provenance, replayable rotation audit, and incident notification SLA <= 2 hours. Also require proof that rotation dry-run can be replayed.
Maya (AE): They mentioned hybrid: primary on-prem HSM + async replication to our Dedicated region for failover. Ask: do we support auto-failover with a remote mirrored key or is that manual?
Ravi (SalesEng): We support both patterns but auto-failover requires delegation to our KMS proxy (ephemeral wrapping keys) which is billable and needs customer consent. Manual failover (operator-driven) is lower risk but longer RTO.
Chris (Infra): For network, we can do VPN or Direct Connect. Need firewall inbound from our Dedicated egress range. Sample firewall ACL they'd expect:
```
ALLOW tcp 443 from 52.14.0.0/16 to 10.10.0.5
ALLOW udp 500,4500 from 52.14.0.0/16 to 10.10.0.0/24
```
Maya (AE): They asked for acceptance criteria. Ravi, can you propose 4 bullet points to include in SOW?
Ravi (SalesEng): Sure: 1) successful encrypt/decrypt on bridged keys, 2) rotation dry-run with no failed requests for 30m window, 3) throughput test: sustained 100 TPS with <50ms extra crypto latency, 4) signed audit bundle delivered to their S3 on rotation events.
Nina (Security): Add: audit entries must include key-id, rotation-timestamp, actor (cert thumbprint), and signed hash. Also require retention proof for 2 years (SLA on availability of logs).
Maya (AE): Procurement wants line-item pricing and a milestone-based SOW. Can legal-bot flag any non-standard clauses?
legal-bot: Flagged: key custody indemnity, data escrow, and incident notification timeline. Recommend adding a clause limiting our liability for customer-managed HSM hardware failure.
Chris (Infra): I'll run a latency sim Wed morning. Need a model and expected crypto op distribution (encrypt vs sign vs unwrap).
Ravi (SalesEng): I'll prepare three price bands: "Connector-only" (customer manages rotations), "Auto-rotate" (we run automated rotation via ephemeral delegation), "Full-managed" (we manage keys in proxy with extended ops & 2yr audit retention).
Maya (AE): They also want a sample run command for the rotation dry-run test to include in SOW. Chris/Nina, propose a safe sim command we can share.
Chris (Infra): Example we can share (staging):
```
./hsm-rotate-check --endpoint vpn://10.10.0.5 --key proj-42 --mode=dryrun --verify-signatures --profile=100tps
```
Nina (Security): We'll require that the dry-run flags generate a signed audit bundle. Format: tar.gz with manifest.json + signatures.
deploy-bot: Uploaded SOW draft and sample runbook https://redwood.internal/sow/POC-1716667777. Please review and comment by EOD PST.
Maya (AE): Great. Ravi - can you send an initial pricing sketch + SOW bullets by EOD? Chris - loop me into the sim Wed. Nina - I'll add security Q answers and share back. Thanks everyone.
